scope: Offline camera-result admission with separate acquisition and delivery clocks; no control permission
clock: Both clocks use seconds in the same externally supplied time domain; finite [0,1e12]; delivery and accepted acquisition advance at least 1e-6 s
expiry: Inclusive age deadline; on expiry drain tracks once at last accepted acquisition + max_age_s; later ticks do not move this barrier
recovery: Required consecutive accepted samples acquired strictly after the latched fault; any rejected sample during hold resets the count
projection: Confirmed/coasting hypotheses only; CV from last observed box and acquisition time to now; per-object age <= min(max_age_s,coast_seconds); confidence unchanged
provenance: SHA-256-pinned image-analysis reports from producer-sources.json or explicitly synthetic inline detections
errors: Invalid delivery clock, schema, provenance or files abort without output; semantic sample rejection is reported without refreshing acquisition
